text: Coffee with Jess. She's got a second interview at the architecture firm sometime next week and is properly nervous about the portfolio part. Her brother Ethan just moved back in with their parents. Text her good luck the night before.

Eamon's band is playing the Crown on May 14. Aisha and Kenji are coming too. He said they've got two new songs, one about his granddad. Aisha is still waiting to hear back about the museum job she interviewed for in early April, should know by mid May. Kenji reckons she's got it. Ask her about it at the gig.

Long call with Malik. He didn't get the logistics job, they went with an internal candidate. Bit flat about it but already applying elsewhere. His wife Dana is running the half marathon early March and he's doing the training runs with her on Sundays. Check in with him end of the month to see how the applications are going.

Niamh's daughter has her piano recital June 3rd. Niamh says she practises every evening and still cries before going on stage. Her husband Anil is filming it for the grandparents in Kerala. Niamh herself has an interview for a deputy head post sometime next week, which she's barely had time to think about. Text her good luck Monday.
Marisol mentioned Delroy is leaving the council after twelve years. Leaving drinks sometime in the last week of April, not confirmed yet.
Need to get Wei a card, he passed his CPA exams! Results came out Friday. His mum is apparently telling the whole street.
Naledi and her husband Mandla are off to Lisbon over the summer for their tenth anniversary. She wants a decent travel camera but won't buy one herself, so maybe a hint for Mandla.
Tamar's audition for the regional orchestra got cancelled, the panel postponed everything indefinitely. She's teaching extra violin lessons in the meantime.
Suzanne called. Lorenzo's mum had a fall on Saturday and is in hospital for a few days. Suzanne is driving up to Bristol tomorrow to help out. Ring her Thursday.
Bumped into Anil after five a side. He's applying for a PhD in Edinburgh, deadline 12/1. Wants me to read his personal statement, so I should block out an evening for that next week.
Eilidh got the job!! Starts at the hospice in early March. She was so sure she'd blown the interview.
Sean's 40th is on 7/19, at his brother's place. Ethan says everyone's chipping in for a road bike so I need to send him money by end of the month.
Adriana is moving to Leeds sometime in the autumn, partner got a transfer. Khadija is gutted, they've been neighbours forever.

Adebayo has a final-round interview at the bank on March 22nd. Third round, panel of five. He hates presentations. Also his cat Biscuit is having teeth out the same week, poor guy. Message him the morning of.

Dinner at Gemma's. Salma was there, she's six months pregnant and craving pickles nonstop. Gemma's son Milan got into the county under-14 squad and plays his first match on April 6. Gemma's husband Dimitri was away in Athens for work. Lovely evening.
Michael is struggling with the job hunt, eight months now and mostly rejections. He's started a coding bootcamp in the evenings. Should take him for a pint sometime next week, he could use it.
Dev and Rafael are doing the Three Peaks challenge in early June for charity. Remind me to sponsor them before they go.
Elena said her dad's retirement do is the end of the month. He's been a train driver for 35 years. She's making a speech and dreading it.
Grocery run tomorrow, then dentist at 4. Car MOT sometime next week.
Jess's nickname is Jessie-J apparently, from uni. Her flatmate Kenji is vegan and gluten free, worth knowing for the barbecue.
Malik's son starts secondary school in September. He's nervous about the bus on his own. Malik isn't much better, ha.
Eamon Fischer from work said he's interviewing for the team lead role on 5/2. Aisha's going for it as well, which is awkward because they share a desk. Ask Eamon how it went after.
Called Aunt Suzanne. Her hip operation is booked for August 11th. She sounded calm but Uncle Delroy says she hasn't been sleeping.

Kenji's half marathon went well, 1:52. Already signed up for Berlin in late September. His girlfriend Jess ran it with him and got a PB, she's chuffed. Jess also mentioned her sister Naledi's band is playing a festival in Brighton over the summer and she wants a group of us to go. I said yes, need to sort a tent.
Niamh says Wei's band won the battle of the bands last weekend. Final round is sometime in May, in Manchester.
I'm doing the cake for Dana's party Saturday. Marisol is bringing drinks. Dana doesn't know about it.
Must reply to Naledi about the reference letter, she needs it by June 9th for the teaching application.

Chat with Tamar after choir. She and her partner Lorenzo are expecting in November! Tamar has had awful morning sickness. Lorenzo is applying for jobs closer to home so he's not commuting three hours a day. They're house hunting over the summer too, looking around Didsbury. She asked me to keep the baby news quiet for now.
Anil's mum passed away last Tuesday. Funeral is Monday the 14th at St Mary's. He's taking a couple of weeks off. Send flowers to the house and check on him over the weekend.
Mandla said he's done applying for jobs, starting his own carpentry business instead. First commission is a dining table for his sister.
Eilidh and Sean are getting married next spring, date probably April 18. Venue's a castle near Inverness. Eilidh's mum is already stressing about the guest list.
Ethan didn't make the cut for the regional swim team. Gutted but says he'll try again in the spring trials.

Lunch with Adriana and Khadija. Adriana's play opens at the Lyceum on October 30 and she's playing the lead, which she says terrifies her. Khadija is doing the lighting. Khadija's girlfriend Salma just started a new job at the BBC. I should get tickets for opening night before they sell out.
Adebayo's dog Rolo went missing yesterday afternoon. Found him this morning in a neighbour's shed.
Remember to ask Gemma how Milan's match went on Saturday.
Dimitri said his brother Michael is getting married in Thessaloniki the first week of July. Whole family flying out. He's dreading the speech as best man.

Michael has a phone screen with Spotify on Wednesday 11/4, then if that goes ok an onsite sometime the week after. He's been prepping case studies all weekend. Text him Tuesday night to wish him luck.
Dev mentioned he's allergic to shellfish, so no paella at the dinner.
Rafael's daughter is doing her grade 5 ballet exam end of the month. He's way more nervous than she is.
Note to self: renew passport before the summer, and book flights for the wedding by mid March.

Caught up with Elena. Her husband Milan got made redundant last month and is applying everywhere. She's picked up extra shifts. Their twins start nursery in January. She's holding it together but only just. Must invite them round for dinner sometime soon.
Jess Moreau, the new project manager, used to row for her uni. Training for a masters race in Henley early July.
Eamon's sister Elena got her Oxford offer! Interview was back in December. Their mum cried down the phone apparently.
Aisha wants a proper coffee grinder, keeps going on about how hers is rubbish. Birthday's 8/22.
Kenji's grandma turns 90 on September 3rd. Big family lunch in Osaka, Kenji's flying out the week before. He wants to bring her something from here but has no idea what.

Marisol got through to the second round for the head of design job. Next stage is a take-home task due sometime next week, then a panel interview. Her boss doesn't know she's looking. Ask her how the panel goes.

Delroy is coaching his son's football team this season, first match Saturday. Says the kids are hopeless but keen. His wife Marisol is away at a conference in Chicago until October 28 so he's doing all the school runs alone. Their eldest has mock exams early November and is stressed. Delroy looked shattered, honestly.

Called Wei. His dad is having heart surgery on June 17th and he's flying back to Singapore for three weeks. His girlfriend Naledi is going with him for the first week. He's trying to sort cover at work and is pretty frazzled. Check in with him the day after the surgery, and maybe drop off some food before they fly.
Tamar's recital was moved from May 20 to June 1st because the hall flooded.
Lorenzo got promoted to sous chef! Didn't even apply, they just offered it.
Picked up the keys for the new flat. Moving in properly sometime next week, painters booked for the end of the month.
Mandla and Niamh's housewarming is on 4/12. Bring wine and the board game they lent me.
Eilidh's brother Dev is running the London Marathon on April 26. First one ever, he's raising money for the stroke charity after their dad's stroke last year. Don't forget to donate.

Sean's been really down since the breakup with Rafael. Moving into his cousin's spare room for a bit. He mentioned he's thinking of applying for jobs in Glasgow to have a fresh start, maybe over the summer. Text him this weekend to see how he's doing.
Gemma said Salma had the baby on Tuesday, a girl, 7lb 2oz. Both doing well. Need to send something.
Adriana MacDonald, Addie to everyone, is the one who runs the climbing wall on Thursdays. Competes in bouldering.
Khadija's interview at the Home Office is March 3rd. She's done three mock interviews with her uncle, who used to work there. Says she feels ready but I know she's anxious.
Dimitri and Elena are doing a pottery course on Tuesdays until early December. Dimitri's pieces are apparently tragic.
Rang Mum. Not much news. She's doing the garden and wants me to come up sometime over the summer.

Spent ages talking to Dev at the work drinks. He has his performance review on 11/18 and is hoping for a promotion to senior engineer, but his manager Suzanne has been vague. His wife Gemma is training for an ultra in the spring and their dog Pepper just had puppies. He's knackered. Should ask him after the 18th how the review went, and maybe bring a coffee that morning.
